title: Choose the narrowest correct pipeline action
description: Inject a code, parameter, or workspace change and choose a response. The graph shows which stages recompute, restore, remain valid, or block.

actions.label: Reproduce the evaluation target
actions.detail: Let DVC traverse dependencies and execute only invalidated stages.

actions.label: Restore from the local cache
actions.detail: Materialize the current revision's output without downloading or recomputing it.

actions.label: Fetch from the team remote
actions.detail: Download the referenced object and restore it into the workspace.

actions.label: Force every stage to rerun
actions.detail: Ignore unchanged-stage reuse and recompute the entire target graph.

scenarios.label: Preprocessing code changed
scenarios.detail: src/prepare.py has a new hash; raw data and parameters are unchanged.
scenarios.reason: The prepare command depends on the changed code. Its new output invalidates both downstream stages.

targeted-repro.headline: Recompute from the first invalid stage
targeted-repro.detail: Prepare, train, and evaluate rerun; raw data remains a valid dependency.

checkout.headline: Checkout would restore a stale model
checkout.detail: The previous model exists, but it was produced by the old preprocessing code.

pull.headline: Pulling old outputs does not satisfy a new dependency hash
pull.detail: Remote availability cannot make the old prepared data valid for the changed code.

force-repro.headline: Correct result, unnecessarily broad execution
force-repro.detail: Every stage reruns, which matches the required graph here but discards any usable run-cache result.

scenarios.label: Training parameter changed
scenarios.detail: train.max_depth changed; prepared data and preprocessing remain valid.
scenarios.reason: Only train declares this parameter key. Train reruns, and its new model invalidates evaluation.

targeted-repro.headline: Reuse preparation and rerun the affected suffix
targeted-repro.detail: Prepare stays valid while train and evaluate produce evidence for the new parameter.

checkout.headline: The cached model belongs to the previous parameter
checkout.detail: Materializing it would not create evidence for the requested max_depth value.

pull.headline: Remote transfer cannot replace required computation
pull.detail: Unless the exact run exists in cache, the new parameter requires training.

force-repro.headline: The result may be valid, but preparation is repeated
force-repro.detail: Forcing the graph ignores a valid prepared-data stage and expands cost and runtime.

scenarios.label: Model deleted; cache is warm
scenarios.detail: The workspace model is absent, but its exact hash remains in the local cache.
scenarios.reason: No declared dependency changed. The desired output can be materialized from the local content-addressed cache.

targeted-repro.headline: Computation is broader than restoration
targeted-repro.detail: The graph is still valid; restore the known object instead of spending training capacity.

checkout.headline: Restore the exact object without recomputation
checkout.detail: DVC links or copies the current revision's model from cache into the workspace.

pull.headline: The result is correct, but network transfer is unnecessary
pull.detail: The exact object is already local, so checkout is the narrower operation.

force-repro.headline: A missing workspace link does not justify a full rebuild
force-repro.detail: All stages rerun even though the current output hash is already cached.

scenarios.label: Model and cache object are missing
scenarios.detail: The Git revision references a model stored in the team remote, but this runner has an empty cache.
scenarios.reason: The revision is valid and the exact object exists remotely. Fetching it preserves provenance and avoids unnecessary training.

targeted-repro.headline: Recomputation discards an available immutable result
targeted-repro.detail: Training can be expensive or nondeterministic; fetch the referenced object when it is available.

checkout.headline: Checkout cannot materialize an object absent from cache
checkout.detail: The metadata identifies the hash, but no local bytes satisfy it.

pull.headline: Fetch and restore the revision's exact model
pull.detail: The remote supplies the missing object; the pipeline remains unchanged.

force-repro.headline: A full rebuild is not the first recovery choice
force-repro.detail: It spends compute and may not reproduce identical bytes even though the exact artifact is available.

notice: The trace models declared DVC dependencies. Undeclared files, external services, environment drift, and nondeterministic code can still change results without appearing in the graph.
